worldcombat.skill.entrainment.summary: Send a beat to one chosen target: a Pokémon temporarily gains the caster's Ability; a non-Pokémon has its movement speed pulled toward the caster's current speed, within a bounded change. Only that one object is affected.
worldcombat.skill.entrainment.use.0: Hand your own detrimental Ability to a foe
worldcombat.skill.entrainment.use.1: Overwrite a dangerous foe Ability with an ordinary one
worldcombat.skill.entrainment.use.2: Pass a strong Ability or speed rhythm to a partner
worldcombat.skill.entrainment.descriptio: Dances a beat toward one target within %1$s blocks after a %2$s s wind-up, travelling at about %3$s blocks/tick.

When the beat arrives, a Pokémon temporarily gains the caster’s Ability. Another creature’s movement speed shifts toward the caster’s by %2$s of their speed difference, subject to the sync limit, for %1$s.
worldcombat.skill.entrainment.snap.0: Snap beat: sync ×1.3, duration ×0.7, cooldown +12 ticks; forces the target onto your tempo at once.
worldcombat.skill.entrainment.snap.1: Loose beat: sync ×0.75, duration ×1.3, cooldown −8 ticks; holds longer but less tightly.
worldcombat.skill.entrainment.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.entrainment.growth.0: From level %1$s, cooldown is reduced by an extra 0.6 seconds.
worldcombat.skill.entrainment.growth.1: From level %1$s, the extra cooldown reduction becomes 1.1 seconds, replacing the earlier reduction.
worldcombat.skill.entrainment.preference: On = snap beat: speed pulled closer (sync ×1.3), duration ×0.7, cooldown +12 ticks, forcing the target onto your tempo now. Off = loose beat: pulled less (×0.75), duration ×1.3, cooldown −8 ticks, held longer but not as tightly. Closeness trades against duration.
Only consider the rhythm against a target inside this distance; larger dances earlier from farther away, smaller only at close range.
On, a holding companion will leave its post to change a foe's Ability or sync a partner; off, it only casts when already in reach.
worldcombat.skill.entrainment.world: A non-Pokémon that catches the beat has its movement speed pulled toward the caster's speed at casting (at most %2$s of its original speed), for %1$s. Cleansing or expiry restores it; other speed effects still apply.
